svg.title: Sheet sizes A0 to A8, nested
svg.desc: A technical drawing: the ISO 216 sizes A0 to A8 drawn from one shared corner, a diagonal through all their opposite corners because every size is 1 : √2, A0 marked 841 × 1189 mm, and a title block: sheet sizes A0 to A8, after Lichtenberg (1786), DIN 476 (1922) and ISO 216 (1975). A0 = 1 m². Each size is half the one before.
